clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Tirisfal, Vicious Night Web Spider Venom carries an old contagion. The Royal Apothecary Society prizes it for holding historical disease strains, and uses it in work on the Forsaken's New Plague.

Apothecary Johaan in Brill studies old texts about a plague that killed thousands. The contagion behind that outbreak endured for centuries inside the venom of local Night Web spiders. Apothecaries hunt the vicious breed in Venomweb Vale, south of the Scarlet Monastery, and draw out the preserved contagion for their alchemical experiments.
